findings.text: This closes the prior review's fit finding at reckon/checkout_trust.py:83 (the plan-document reference) without a guard: the ban on plan references in source comments is enforced by the review check (the banned-prose grep returns no hit in any added line) rather than by a test, so a future edit could reintroduce the reference and no stored gate would redden. Worth recording because the remediation is a convention, not a mechanism.

The reviewed run's after_suite arm was run at 325a5df12, one comment-only commit before the reviewed head 9e346b0d1; the full 13-file suite was not re-run at the head. The gap is benign here because 9e346b0d1 changes only comment text and the node re-ran its own test file at the head (node-tests-style-fix.log, 12 passed, EXIT=0), so the comment-only claim is verified; the recording is noted so a reader does not read the after arm as taken at the head.

justifications.durability: The gained commit is comment-only and adds no assertions, so nothing can regress behaviourally; no stored gate asserts the plan reference is absent (that ban is enforced by review discipline, not by tests/test_a_moved_checkout_is_proved_importable_once.py), so the remediation is not itself guarded.
justifications.evidence: The head-arm result is recorded in node-tests-style-fix.log (rev=9e346b0d1, 12 passed, EXIT=0) and the node's own arm delta is in baseline-suite.log (87 passed) against after-suite.log (99 passed, EXIT=0), so the numbers are logged rather than claimed.

justifications.scope_discipline: The 9e346b0d1 diff touches one file, reckon/checkout_trust.py, which is a declared write path (manifest.md:3) and carries nothing the gained commit's goal does not imply.
